title: Gate change
instructions: Havalimanında hızlı bir anons. Kısa ama bilgi dolu; değişen bilgileri yakala. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: This is a message for passengers on flight TK 482 to Berlin.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The flight will now leave from gate fourteen, not gate forty.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Boarding will start at eleven fifty, thirty minutes later than planned.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Passengers with small children can board first.

questions.prompt: Which gate does the flight leave from now?
questions.feedback: Artık on dört numaralı kapı (gate fourteen), kırk değil.
Biniş on bir elli'de (eleven fifty) başlıyor.
questions.evidence: Boarding will start at eleven fifty

questions.prompt: What time was boarding planned before?
questions.feedback: Biniş planlanandan otuz dakika geç; 11:50 − 30 dakika = 11:20. İki bilgiyi birleştirmen gerek.

questions.prompt: Who can get on the plane first?
questions.evidence: Passengers with small children can board first.
